__TOC__
==Description==
The '''Flare''' was an enemy that appeared on the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a moderate amount of health and a slightly fast speed. Upon its death, it would create an explosion, stunning any tower caught in its radius.

==Appearance==
The '''Flare''' had neon yellow skin. It had neon purple shoulder-pads with red spikes.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Minigunner]] are recommended to kill this enemy.
**If possible, you should place these towers away from the path so they are less likely to be stunned.
**As the [[Ranger]] is a cliff tower, it will be stunned less by the '''Flare'''.
*You can use the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Sledger]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow this enemy down.
**Do note that the [[Sledger]] is more likely to be stunned by the '''Flare''' as it has to be placed closer to the path.
*Several [[Ace Pilot]]s or [[Pursuit]]s can help to take down the '''Flare''' as they cannot be stunned by it.
